exposure.needed: the size of the TLS trust bundles (PEM data) supplied to cert-manager, relative to the previous parse limit of pki.DecodeX509CertificateSetBytes — the previous and new limits are not stated in the evidence

consequence.statement: pki.DecodeX509CertificateSetBytes now parses a larger amount of PEM data than before, so cert-manager can read larger TLS trust bundles; nothing fails, existing configurations keep working, and no operator action is required, though environments using large trust bundles may want to verify they are now handled.
consequence.remediation: No action required; operators relying on large TLS trust bundles may verify they are now read successfully.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 increases the amount of PEM data that pki.DecodeX509CertificateSetBytes can parse, enabling cert-manager to read larger TLS trust bundles.
